titles.title: Homeowners Premium Tax Reduction Act of 2026
Homeowners Premium Tax Reduction Act of 2026
To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to create an above the line deduction for certain homeowners insurance premiums.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

bill.summary:
Homeowners Premium Tax Reduction Act of 2026
This bill establishes a new deduction of up to $10,000 claimed against gross income (above-the-line tax deduction) for annual policy premiums paid or incurred for homeowners insurance on an individual's principal residence.
